newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian right-wing fighters kill four peasants.
newsitem.headline: Colombian right-wing fighters kill four peasants.

text.p: Suspected right-wing paramilitary fighters killed four peasants in northern Colombia before dawn on Tuesday, taking to 11 the number killed in the area this week, police said.
In the latest attack, near Aguas Blancas in Cesar province, the victims were dragged from their homes and shot, a police spokesman in the provincial capital Valledupar said.
Three people were murdered in similar circumstances in the town of Badillo on Monday and four were killed in the nearby town of La Paz over the weekend.

"It's possible that this points to an increase in paramilitary violence," the spokesman said. "There's quite a heavy guerrilla presence in this part of Cesar but I don't think they were behind this (these killings) because the people in this area support them," he added.

Right-wing paramilitary gangs launched an offensive this year, trying to wipe out leftist guerrillas from much of northern Colombia. The paramilitary groups frequently target civilians suspected of sympathising with the rebels.
A right-wing death squad killed about 30 people in a village in the eastern province of Meta this month in one of the worst massacres in Colombia since 1994.
